Even perfect witness subtraction leaves an exact physical-identity ambiguity: exchanging a hypothetical exotic voltage with an unmonitored ordinary voltage at the same port preserves both raw observations.
limits: This is a single-frequency effective-voltage model, not a field solution, built detector, gravity mechanism, energy-extraction experiment or dark-matter sensitivity calculation.
